description: This file defines the HttpClient class responsible for handling HTTP file downloads using libcurl, including methods for controlling download progress, rate limiting, and SSL configuration. It also includes a utility class for tracing function entry and exit.

classes.name: HttpClient
classes.description: A class providing HTTP client functionalities such as downloading files, controlling transfer rate, and managing connection status using libcurl.

classes.name: trace_exit
classes.description: A utility class for tracing function entry and exit for debugging purposes.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file from the specified URL to a local filename with optional rate limiting.

methods.name: setRateLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum receive speed for the download.

methods.name: getProgress
methods.description: Returns the current progress of the download.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the last request.

methods.name: progressCb
methods.description: Static callback function for tracking download progress.

methods.name: write_data
methods.description: Static callback function for writing received data to a file.

methods.name: trace_exit
methods.description: A utility class for tracing function entry and exit for debugging.
